excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一艘古老的外星人星舰，它被半掩埋在一个小行星撞击坑中间。冰晶布满了舰身的大部分，但我们还是很顺利地发现了气阀门……并开始搜索这艘船暗藏的秘密。
excerpt.en: We have discovered an ancient alien starship lying half-buried in an asteroid crater. Glacial ice has inexorably spread across most of the ship, but we can easily access the airlock... and search for any secrets hidden behind it.

sections.zh: 我们发现了一艘古老的外星人星舰，它被半掩埋在一个小行星撞击坑中间。冰晶布满了舰身的大部分，但我们还是很顺利地发现了气阀门……并开始搜索这艘船暗藏的秘密。
sections.en: We have discovered an ancient alien starship lying half-buried in an asteroid crater. Glacial ice has inexorably spread across most of the ship, but we can easily access the airlock... and search for any secrets hidden behind it.

texts.zh: 当我们打开这艘外星人星舰的气阀门时，等待在另一边的是一片修罗地狱。我们初步调查发现，这里简直就是一片残杀现场。在检查支离破碎的船员尸体之后，我们很确定他们生前正互相撕扯对方的四肢。我们可以转身就走……但那样我们就永远没法发现这场悲剧是怎么发生的了。
texts.en: When we opened the airlock of the alien starship, putrefaction and decay awaited us on the other side. Our preliminary investigation has uncovered a scene of carnage. After examining the mutilated bodies of the crew, we are certain they tore each other limb from limb. We could just leave... but then we'd never know why this tragedy happened.

texts.zh: 随着进一步的发掘，我们找到了这艘船的科学实验室。微弱的能量布满这片区域，泛出轻柔的紫外光。一片凌乱的紫色灌木正在厚重的孢子云。看来，这艘船的医生利用实验室和通风闸将一片有毒的云雾排放到了飞船的每一个角落。
texts.en: Digging deeper, we have uncovered the ship's science lab. Minimal power saturates the scene in ultraviolent illumination. A riot of purple shrubbery is releasing thick clouds of spores. The ship's doctor used a laboratory and ventilation shafts to flood the ship with an intoxicating mist.

texts.zh: 我们认为自己能免疫这片有毒云雾带来的危害。如果我们能让飞船的引擎运作起来，我们就能启动这艘船并将其送回母星研究。这需要时间，但这座精密的药学实验室能为我们帝国的士兵们提供有用的生物增强剂。
texts.en: We think we are immune to the full effects of the intoxicating mist. If we can get the ship's engines online, we can launch the ship and send it back home for study. This will take time, but the elaborate pharmaceutical laboratory may provide useful biochemical augmentation for our empire's soldiers.

label.zh: 运行诊断程序，并开始修复。

texts.zh: 我们愚蠢地以为我们能够免疫这片云雾，但是我们的工程师们已经陷入了销魂极乐的状态。他们在飞船的过道跳舞，大声地唱歌。我们需要时间对空气进行净化，抓住这帮子工程师，然后才能发动飞船。这些耽搁会花费我们的时间。
texts.en: We foolishly thought we were immune to the mist, but our engineers are experiencing a state of rapturous bliss. They dance in the ship's corridors, singing atonally. We will need to clear the atmosphere and capture our engineers before we can launch the ship. This delay will cost us time.

label.zh: 抓住已经陷入“极乐”的工程师。

texts.zh: 我们愚蠢地以为自己能够免疫这片云雾，但是我们的科学家们已经在经受心理狂躁的苦果。在飞船的每一个角落都有打斗发生。我们需要时间对空气进行净化，镇压住这群云雾的受害者，然后才能发动飞船。这些耽搁会花费我们的时间。
texts.en: We foolishly thought that we were immune to the mist, but our scientists are experiencing fits of psychotic rage. Fighting has broken out shipwide. We will need to clear the atmosphere and subdue the mist's victims before we can launch the ship. This delay will cost us time.

texts.zh: 我们起飞了！尽管很危险，但外星人飞船的有毒迷雾确实能够增强我们帝国士兵的战斗力和忠诚心。然而，问题还是存在：我们应该让自己的士兵去接触这种有害的物质吗？或者我们从这场悲剧的错误中学得教训，放弃这一切？
texts.en: We have liftoff! Though dangerous, the alien ship's intoxicating mist could augment the effectiveness and loyalty of our empire's soldiers. However, the question remains: should we subject our own soldiers to this hazardous substance? Or should we say no and learn from their tragic mistakes?

label.zh: 好好利用这个令人惊叹的科技。
